name: ETL AppsFlyer Data Locker To BigQuery
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **AppsFlyer Data Locker** as the data source.
2.  Select your added BigQuery data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your AppsFlyer Data locker using the [+](https://api.datachannel.co/datasources/appsflyer-datalocker/credentials/add?token=eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImM4MjNkMWE0MTg5ZjI3NThjYWI4NDQ4ZmQ0MTIwN2ViZGZhMjVlMzkiLCJ0eXAiOiJKV1QifQ..InIoCRlI7SLxK9CUoxrxPfZpUTU89H7utex7gdHH8pggY_rD32a9McpDtu_VtsIlyOFuEUclUIQH-AJJO5G4ofHVUN4n1WzxojsSmJutjeVUX-Ypyw1UDX0s_v28sZxAIk0j4xc9y7RC9K4Kms22qhV7gXhDdWBBs2tdPuVpvtMa9ozxDysPFhS2hc_33tvbOyzR1nyP7Kd7dWykk8aNFnF98u21LPYfpUDKyoD1P88OuGyaoeTJBpZb81eumrIXuEqM6C44k21ReljYoc03EeHMxLSpCk0WIFdXSwUV2X6aSoXxwf2ZXSRcelfilXbWeLZFtzcwV3jVBxfAHzSLog) icon with your **AWS details (Access Key, Secret Key, Bucket Name & AWS Location)**.
4.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/appsflyer-datalocker/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
